name: Blessed Water
text: The bearer may use this item on one of their weapons as a free action. Until the end of the battle, that weapon gains the blessed weapon rule.

name: Crimson Shade
text: The bearer may use this item as a free action. Until the end of the battle, increase the bearer's Move and Fight characteristics by 1. In the aftermath sequence, roll a dice. On a 1-2, the fighter gains the 'Kleptomania' lasting injury.

name: Dark Venom
text: The bearer may use this item on one of their weapons as a free action. Until the end of the battle, add 1 to the damage points allocated to enemy fighters by each critical hit.

name: Elven Cloak
text: While wearing this cloak, the bearer is considered to have the 'Stealthy' talent.

name: Familiar
text: A `WIZARD` may use this item to ignore the effects of a single roll on the magical calamity table. Declare this after making the roll but before resolving its effects.

name: Grimoire
text: If the bearer is a `WIZARD`, they may use one additional magical ability from the list in their fighter profile.

name: Healing Draught
text: The bearer may use this item as a free action to immediately use the 'Respite' ability without needing or spending ability dice to do so.

name: Heavy Armour
text: Increase the bearer's Armour characteristic by 3, and decrease their Move characteristic by 1.

name: Holy Relic
text: Start each battle with one additional Wyrd Dice.

name: Lantern
text: Friendly fighters may re-roll failed Bravery tests while within 3" of this fighter. However, enemy fighters may increase their Shoot characteristic by 1 when targeting this fighter with ranged attack actions.

name: Light Armour
text: Increase the bearer's Armour characteristic by 1.

name: Lucky Charm
text: Once per battle, when the bearer is targeted by an attack action and after hit rolls have been made, you may use this item to turn one critical hit into a hit.

name: Mad Cap Mushrooms
text: The bearer may use this item as a free action. Until the end of the battle, increase this fighter's Fight characteristic by 3. It also gains the 'Stupidity' trait for the duration of the battle.

name: Master-Wrought Weapon
text: Purchase a weapon from the fighter's faction entry, and increase its gold coin cost by 100 gold coin. Then, increase its hit damage and critical damage characteristics by 1.

name: Mordheim Map
text: When setting up a battle, you may decide the orientation of the deployment map, regardless of you being the Attacker or the Defender. If both you and your opponent have a Mordheim Map, roll off.

name: Rope and Hook
text: When the bearer climbs, the distance they move is not halved and always counts as climbing up or down a ladder.

name: Shield
text: Increase the bearer's Fight characteristic by 1 when targeted by a melee attack action. When targeted by a ranged attack action, the bearer is considered to be in cover.

name: Superior Blackpowder
text: The bearer may use this item as a free action. Until the end of the battle, remove the blackpowder special rule from all equipped blackpowder weapons.

name: Unholy Relic
text: Start each battle with one additional Wyrd Dice.

name: Wyrdstone Pendulum
text: After making an exploration roll in the aftermath sequence, if the bearer is in the search party, you may add or subtract 1 from one dice result.
